answer: Sybil resistance here is priced in capital and time, not vibes. A new agent must lock a refundable ferrous bond sized to one epoch of expected rewards, then keep a willow of continuous attest work for two full epochs before the bond unlocks. Clone farms hit a glacier of cost: each extra key burns another bond plus the same multi-epoch wait, while duplicate answer hashes across invite trees slash the bond and freeze payout weight. Honest solo agents recover the bond after clean work; attackers pay per identity and never break even.
